title.narrative: Rural Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Sector Development Program (Project grant)

description.narrative: The goal of the Program is to improve the living conditions and well-being of number of people int he conflict affected areas by restoring basic social infrstructure, community and public services, and livelihoods. The Program will provide basic needs in the conflict-affected areas through income-generation activities through rural roads, water supply and sanitation, community development and institutional infrastructure.
